Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
What's that crowd, I wonder？
Looks like some kind of location shoot... Ah, look！ They're filming！ Want to watch？
...If you want to watch. I'm fine, I think？
I'm not that into it either... but are you sure？
Yes. Because time spent with you is important... I'm kidding. Let's go♪
？ What are you doing？
Takane
Ah, sorry. I saw a friend, a girl from the next class.
A girl？ Someone I know？
...Geez. I'm never telling you.
(I didn't mean it like that！)
Takane
...Hey, that vending machine... "oden"...
Yeah, oden. With real ingredients in it.
So it's not oden-flavored juice...
Eh!?
Ah... I know. There's no way there'd be oden-flavored juice, right？ Um... that was funny, right？
(Oden-flavored juice... that'd be intense...)
Takane
...Eek.
Whoa！
...Mm. Hey, you saw that woman's skirt flip up, didn't you？
But it was just for a second.
...If the same thing happened to me and other people saw, how would you feel？
Absolutely not！
Then you absolutely can't either！ Understand？
(I will do my best...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, over here.
Takane
Eh... why？
...Those guys over there were looking at you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Really...？ Not just your imagination？
...Hehe, okay. Thank you for protecting me.
Takane
There's a family restaurant over there, right？
With a drink bar, how many glasses could you drink？
Who knows... If it were free drinks while working a part-time job, I could go forever.
Forever？ If everyone were like that, the drinks would run out. What would they do then？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ gets curious about weird things sometimes...)
Takane
Ah... What a lovely cafe.
Yeah. Kind of, you know, very French.
If someone whispered love to you in a place like that, I bet lots of girls wouldn't want to go home.
Je t'aime, ▲高嶺＊＊▲▼
That doesn't count here. Hehe！
Takane
Ah, that person too... Hey, lately I see lots of people outside carrying game consoles...
Ah, probably for StreetPass.
Streetpass？
If you pass someone while both carrying the same console, you can do all sorts of things. Trade data, battle...
Amazing！ Just by passing each other？ You don't need a cord？
(A "cord"... She sounds like a grandma...)
Takane
There are people texting while walking. Isn't that dangerous？
Probably. You have to watch out for bikes and cars――
Ah！？
...Walking and talking without looking ahead is dangerous too. ...Let's be careful too.
Yes... That surprised me...
Takane
Ah. Did you notice？ Lightning.
Rain's coming... It's a sudden downpour！
Eh, really？
Take cover！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, your hand！
...Hehe, okay. Um... dash？
Yeah, dash！
Takane
Nice weather, isn't it？
You must be a sunshine girl, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Aren't you the sunshine boy？
Who knows... Maybe we're both actually rain people, and two negatives make a positive？
Either way, it means we're a perfect match？ Hehe！
Takane
Ah, look！ The electronic billboard.
"I love you, Yukiko！" Whoa, a confession！ Should I have done it like that？
That's... no good.
Hm？
Because I was happy you told me you loved me directly... So... you know？
Takane
Hm？
Eek！
▲Takane＊＊▲！？
S... Sorry. I was watching someone who almost tripped, and then I... Geez, how embarrassing.
(Yeah, it's embarrassing when you do it yourself...)
Takane
It seems celebrities often come to that ramen shop.
Huh, celebrities even you would know, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...There you go again. Even I know some.
Right, sorry. So, who？
...I forgot. This conversation is over.
(I should stop pushing further...)
Takane
Ah, look？ A stylish couple.
Yeah. How do you get that good a sense of style？
Just research, maybe？ You're more than enough as you are now, though...
And you're more than enough as you are now, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
...You're so careless with your words. Geez.
Takane
Rain...？
Yeah. A sunshower... a "fox's wedding."
Then, maybe I'll marry you too... Just kidding.
Hm？ What did you say？
...Geez.
Takane
Ah. Hey, that song just now...
Hm？ Was something playing？
You didn't hear it？ Um... what was it called？
What was it like？ If you sing it, I might know.
Well......... I forgot. I wonder if it'll play again？ Now it's bugging me.
(Now it's bugging me too！)
Takane
Ah, I kicked a pebble.
Pass！
Eh... um, pass...？
Nice assist！
Gooooal！ All right, a reward hug！
Not happening. Hehehe！
Takane
Hey, look at the upper wall of that building？
Hm？ ...What's that？ That door.
"Emergency Exit," it says, but... there are no stairs, right？
...Nope. More than that, isn't it weird to have an emergency exit sign on the outside？
Yes... it's not just unusual... it's a little scary, isn't it？ Why would...
(A scared ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is pretty rare too...)
Takane
Hey, have you ever taken one of those tissue packs they hand out？
Of course. You haven't, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
No... Taking things for free makes me feel bad...
...Maybe next time I'll work up the courage and take one.
(Courage... is that really needed？)
Takane
Hey, near the top of that building. Is that a person up there？
Hmm. It kind of looks like one, but who knows？
Mm......... I can't see well...
...With a defenseless face like that, I'll play a prank on you！
Eh？ Ah, I'm not making that face. ...Geez.
Takane
Ah, a large puddle.
If I had rain boots on, I'd want to go splashing！
Go ahead. I'll watch▼
Roger. Here I go！
Eh... sorry, I meant it as a joke...！
Haha, I know！
Ah... Geez！
Takane
The parasol on the person walking ahead of us is lovely.
Parasols, huh... Guys don't really have much to do with them.
You think？ Then maybe I'll give you one as a present？
What！ A parasol... for me!?
Hehe. I think it'd be cute？
No way！
Takane
That baby we just passed was so cute, wasn't it？
He was smiling at you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, wasn't he？ Like, all big grin.
Yes, so nice... Hey, do you like babies too？
Hm？ Well, I guess.
I'm glad♪
Takane
Hey, what kind of tree is that little tree, I wonder？ Do you know？
The one with the little red berries？
Yes. I've always wondered, and I mean to look it up, but I forget once I get home.
Haha, I know how that goes. And you'll forget today too, and next time we'll have the same conversation.
I know how that goes！ Just kidding.
Takane
I wish we could see clouds shaped like this together again...
Cloud shape？
Yes. They change with the seasons, right？
I see. Then we'll be having this same talk again next year, huh.
That's how it'll be. Just kidding, hehe！
Takane
Ah, a bookstore.
Hm？ Want to stop by？
Um... no, not right now, I think？
Haha, what's that？ Then why'd you say "bookstore"？
Why, I wonder... It just came out. Um... Teehee♪
Takane
Hey, that... lump？ It's been there for a while. What is it？
Ah, that... Some kind of art object, I guess.
I wonder. But nobody's looking at it.
Yeah. Even though it's got such presence.
Yes, so let's look at it properly for it？
(Staaare...)
Takane
See that empty space over there？
Ah, it says "Tenants Wanted."
I heard a rumor a Winning Burger is going in there. Is it true, I wonder？
Who knows... I mean, it's super tiny？
Right... It's only about the size of a station kiosk...
(Actually, I kind of want to see that...)
Takane
Those dolls waving their arms at construction sites...
Hm？ Scary？
...Why do you look so happy？
It's a boyfriend's duty to protect his scared girlfriend！
Always making things up. That's not it... Geez, never mind.
Takane
Ah, a maid.
Handing out flyers. Did a maid cafe open？ Hmm... but still, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Okay, that's enough.
▲Takane＊＊▲？
You're trying to make me blush again. I won't fall for it.
(You're already blushing...)
Takane
......Hey, that plane's shape is unusual, isn't it？
Hmm. True... it looks like a car.
I saw on the news that they're developing a flying car overseas... No way, right？
No way！ It's too far to tell, but it might be a blimp.
Yes...
(...No way, right？)
Takane
Lots of pigeons on the power line...
Yeah. Scary to walk under！
Really？ They're cute. Let's go that way？
No way！ Look, you can see it. *Plop*...
Ah... yes, I'll just look from far away.
Takane
Nobody really uses that pedestrian bridge, huh.
There's a crosswalk right next to it.
Yes... Maybe that's why it's getting so rusty, since nobody uses it.
Maybe. ...All right, let's try crossing it！
Hehe, okay.
Takane
"Don't you rush / there's time enough / take it slow"
Hm？ Ah, a traffic safety slogan. An elementary schooler made it.
Now, let's hear one from you. Go.
Eh！ Um... "So cute / Manaka Takane is / mine all mine！" There！
...That's not a slogan or anything. ...Geez.
Takane
Ah, a cute taxi.
Where？ I mean... a cute taxi？
Yes. Lots of stuffed animals. It's decorated with lace, too.
A woman driver, then.
No, it was an old man. Cute, right？
(...Really？)
Takane
Ah！？
Hm？ What's up？
Just now, over there... a really big rat...
Ah, sewer rats show up sometimes.
No, even bigger... like a dog.
A dog-sized rat!?
Maybe I saw wrong... but...
(What is with Towano City...)
Takane
Wow... Those are called classic cars, right？ Cars like that.
Yeah, cool. Looks like a lot of maintenance, though.
I guess when you love something, even the hard parts are fun.
...！ Just like how I feel about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...That's not it. I don't like people with no tact.
(She's angry. Understanding women is difficult...)
Takane
Ah！ ...Oh no.
Huh？ What？
That doll standing over there... I thought it was a person...
(The old fried chicken mascot... Maybe she's never seen it？)
Takane
A little bento shop opened over there.
Oh yeah. Maybe I'll try buying from there sometime.
Why？
...I make yours. So, no. ...Your answer？
Yes, ma'am.
Takane
Hm？
Rock, paper... scissors.
Ah!!
You're it▼ Come and get me！
Ah, hey, no fair！
Takane
Hey, that's a candy shop, but there are games in it？
The game corner at a candy shop, huh. Fighting games.
Fighting... Hmm.
Interested？ Gonna go find someone stronger than you？
Geez, is that an impression of something？ Hehe.
Takane
...Hey, the thing standing over there... it's a person, right？
Probably some kind of performance. Painted all over... that looks rough.
Yes... The paint keeps your skin from breathing, so they probably can't do it long.
Knowing that and doing it anyway, that's the soul of an artist... Splendid！
Geez, what's that？ ...Hehehe！
Takane
Wow, those clothes are cute▼
Yeah, they'd look great on you！ Try them on！
Eh... is it okay？ Making a detour...
Yes, teacher！ I believe detours are part of the date！
...Hehe！ Then just trying them on. I won't stay long, okay？ Just kidding.
Takane
...Oh no！ Hehe！
Wh-What？
That sign... It doesn't say "ramen," it says "raemn"...
"Raemn"... it's true！ I never noticed... I must've seen it a bunch of times.
"Raemn"... Hehehe, oh geez.
Takane
I wonder if it'll be sunny tomorrow...
Tomorrow？ Why？
I want to air out my futon. I couldn't today.
I see. When did I last air mine, I wonder.
A fluffy futon feels nice, you know？ Want me to help？
It's fine, I'll do it myself！
Takane
Can you say the order of the traffic light colors from memory？
Huh. From the left～...
From the left？
...Yellow's in the middle！
Correct！ ...Geez. Hehe！
Takane
Hey, what's that strange vehicle？
Ah, that's one of those stand-up scooters. Apparently it's popular overseas.
Hmm... Looks fun. I want to ride one.
It'd be even better if there was a two-seater！
Hehe, yes. Maybe I'll look it up later？
Takane
How do gardeners make such clean lines, I wonder？
Hm？ Ah, that garden over there.
I don't think I could even make it flat and level.
Ah, this side's too high. Huh？ This side too. And while you go "huh, huh, huh"...
Hehe, yes, there's nothing left. I'd probably do that too.
Takane
Hm？
That person's clothes...
Ah！ Same as mine.
So this kind of thing happens...
(It's somehow awkward...)
Takane
Hey, have you ever walked along just the white lines on the road？
Like "You can only step on the white parts of the crosswalk！"？
Uh-huh. Kids are masters at turning anything into a game, right？
Yeah... Ah, don't tell me that face means...
Hehe, correct. Until we get there, okay？ Ready, go！
Takane
Barber poles are mysterious, aren't they？
Mysterious？ There are various theories about where the colors come from, right？
Yes. But why make it a spiral？ And then spin it around...
(Now I'm curious too. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ gets hung up on strange things sometimes.)
Takane
Ah. The smell of a bakery.
Yeah. That smell makes me hungry. That's a low blow！
Maybe it's a low... dough？ Um... you know, as in bread dough...
!! A pun... from you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲!?
...You don't have to be that surprised, do you？ Geez.
Takane
Look out！ A bee！
Eh, where!?
On your shoulder... Ah, it flew off. Sorry for startling you.
No problem. More importantly, I'm glad it didn't go to you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Geez. Always worrying about me. Take care of yourself too, okay？
Takane
If we walked without paying attention to each other... would our speeds be different, I wonder？
Probably. Our strides are different too.
Right？ ......
Hm？
You really are kind. Hehe！
(When she says it out loud, it's kind of embarrassing...)
Takane
Ah. Sticky burrs.
Oh yeah... wait, are they called "kuttsuki-mushi" or "hittsuki-mushi"？
You mean cocklebur, right？ I wonder if there are lots of names... I'll have to look it up when I get home.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ really loves looking things up.)
Takane
That might be the first time in ages I've heard the paper recycling truck.
True. I feel like I heard it when I was little.
Not many people say "chirigami" for tissues anymore, right？ Are there other words like that？
"Emonkake," maybe？ For a clothes hanger. I think my relatives said it.
"Emonkake"！ Hey, any others？
(There goes ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s curiosity again...)
Takane
The person who just biked past us was humming.
Really？ I didn't notice...
They were really good, you know？ With vibrato and everything.
Haha！ That's beyond humming.
Maybe. Hehe！
Takane
The girl playing over there is good at skipping.
Oh, she is. Can you skip, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...I can, you know？ It's just a little more of a unique rhythm than other people's.
A unique rhythm...？ Hey, right here――
...If I skipped somewhere like this, it'd bother people, right？ Come on, let's go.
(Suspicious...)
Takane
Ah, they're sprinkling water.
Yeah. Sprinkling water isn't just a summer thing, you know.
Yes. It also keeps the dust down.
I see.
We used to do it at home a long time ago. Maybe I'll do it again？
Takane
You know that game where you do rock-paper-scissors and move forward saying "cho-ko-re-i-to" or "pa-i-na-tsu-pu-ru"？
Ah, the one we always played as kids？
Yes. ...Would it be embarrassing to do it now？
There's no word "embarrassing" in a lovey-dovey couple's dictionary！
Geez, lovey-dovey couple... But yes, you're right. Then, rock, paper...
(Scissors！)
Takane
Hey, why is "janken" called "janken"？
That was sudden. Hmm, "ken" must mean fist, probably.
Then what about "jan"？
"Ta-daan！" because you throw out your fist.
Hehe, really？ Then... what about the "pon" in "jan-ken-pon"？
(Ugh, is she expecting a funny answer...)
Takane
Don't you feel like you don't see sparrows much lately？
Apparently their numbers are dropping. Nobody knows why.
I see... Ah, there's one. ...Cute.
I hope they figure out the cause.
Yes...
Takane
Why are pigeons so calm, I wonder？
Even when people come, they don't try to fly... When they do move, they just stroll.
Maybe they think they're human？
Haha, maybe！ Like, "You walk on the edge！"
And we go, "Sorry, Mr. Pigeon." Just kidding. Hehe！
Takane
Ah... in my eye...
You okay？ Maybe stuff gets in easily because your eyes are big, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Is that so...？ Hmm, maybe I should walk squinting. That sounds tiring.
(That's dangerous...)
Takane
Ah！？
Hm？ What's up？
What... a spiderweb？
Are you okay？
Yes. But I broke the web.
You didn't mean to, so it can't be helped.
I need to be careful. Maybe I was too caught up in talking.
Takane
？ Hey, was that sign always there？
Hm？ ...I don't recognize it, that's for sure.
A deer crossing sign... Deer don't come out here, right？
A mistake？ Or maybe they actually started showing up？
That'd be amazing, wouldn't it？ I'm a little excited. Hehe！
Takane
That sound just now...
A starter pistol？ Maybe there's an event somewhere.
It kind of makes you want to start running, doesn't it？
Yeah. Then if it goes off again, on your mark, go！
Hehe, I won't lose.
(You're serious, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ I can't win this...)
Takane
Ah. Car with yellow plates, number one.
What was that again？ If you find 100, something good happens, something like that？
Yes, yes. Can I find them all today, I wonder？
Even without finding them, happiness is right in front of you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... See！
...Yes, you're right. Hehehe！
(It got a laugh...)
Takane
Wow, a rainbow...！
Yeah. And it's not even raining... how come？
Yes, it's strange.
Our combined power is summoning miracles！
Hehe！ I hope lots more things like this happen, okay？
Takane
Ah, soap bubbles.
From that kid over there. So innocent.
Makes you want to sing, doesn't it？
Go ahead, go ahead！
...Actually, I'll pass. Next time, okay？
(Darn.)
Takane
That boy just now was speaking English, wasn't he？
Yeah. And so little...
His mom seemed Japanese, so maybe he's half？
Maybe. It'd be cool if a kid could speak English. Might be nice to teach our own kids someday, huh？
...Geez, it's unfair that you say that without even thinking.
Huh？
Takane
Ah！？
▲Takane＊＊▲！
Phew... Looks like you didn't bump into anything.
Hm？ Did that scare you？
No, it's just that you worried about me right away... Thank you, always.
Takane
Ah.
Hm？
Found a mole. So you have one there...
Huh, where, where？
It's a secret. Just for me to know. Just kidding.
Takane
？ What is it？
You have really long eyelashes, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Really？ ...But why bring that up now？
I could go on forever, you know？ Your eyes are big and cute, your skin's beautiful, and...
Stop！ ...Geez.
(But it's true！)
Takane
Eek！
!? What's wrong？
Just now, my back... you stroked it, didn't you？
Me？ ...I didn't？
Eh... Then... who...？
...Sorry. It was me.
Geez！
Takane
Whenever I pass a cake shop, I want to go in...
Even though you can make them yourself？
Of course. If I make them, I can make them how I like, but I can't beat a shop.
You think？
Yes. But I'm happy you say that.
Takane
Walking around like this... there are all kinds of house nameplates, aren't there？
There are. Wood, stone, metal...
...What kind would you want？
Hm？
......I'm just talking to myself！
Takane
Look, see. A round mailbox.
Was that always there？
Yes, I never noticed. I might like it better than the square ones.
It's cute, huh？
Yes▼ We used to have a piggy bank shaped like that at home... I'll ask if it's still around.
Takane
Did you see the license plate on the car that just passed？
I didn't. Was it an unusual number？
It was the same as your birthday.
What！ I wish I'd seen it！
I wish I'd noticed sooner too. I'll watch out next time, okay？
(I wonder if a car with ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday on the plate will come by.)
Takane
Hey, there was one on that vending machine too... what's the 4-digit display for？
Ah, it's a lottery vending machine. If you win, you get another drink.
Eh, amazing.
It hardly ever happens, though.
What a bargain vending machine. ...But could I drink two？
(She won't keep buying until she wins... right？)
Takane
I love walking past the flower shop.
Because it smells good？
That too, but it makes me feel kind of fresh and lively.
So the flowers give you energy.
Yes▼ Maybe I'll buy some to take home.
Takane
Someone's walking while eating a croquette...
Ah, apparently there's a butcher around here selling fresh-fried croquettes. They say they're good.
Hmm...
Want to stop by？ Since we're here！
Yes... I'm curious, but... hmm...
(Eating while walking might be a big hurdle for her...)
Takane
Lots of the streetlights in Towano City are cute, aren't they？
Huh？ Oh, they are...
Hehe！ I guess guys really don't pay attention to cute things？
I'll leave that department to you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Yes, leave it to me▼ Just kidding.
Takane
Why am I getting asked for directions so much today, I wonder？
Maybe you're giving off a nice-person aura？
Hehe, what's that？ ...But maybe it's because we're always laughing when we're together, so we're easy to approach.
I see... Yeah, could be.
Right？ I hope we can always be like this, us two.
Takane
Ah, a balloon.
Something's tied to the end of the string... A letter？
Maybe. I hope it's carried far, far away, and the person who let it go finds a good match.
Then let's send it some good vibes. From both of us！
Agreed. Hehe！
Takane
!? A pay phone is ringing...
So pay phones can ring...
Hey, should I answer it？
It's probably a wrong number or some test. More importantly, isn't it scary？
？ Why？ It surprised me, but...
(Too bad...)
Takane
Not many people or cars today, huh？
There was a drama or movie like this. Everyone in the world disappears.
Then are we the only two in the world right now？
All right... ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Too bad！
Takane
Whoa, a really big shoe... Is it a sign？
You could fit right inside that, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes. If someone actually had feet that size, how tall would they be, I wonder？
Hmm... about 100 meters？
......I can't picture it. But I'd kind of like to see the view from up there.
Takane
That red motorbike the mail carrier rides is so cute.
Cute？ Not cool？
Yes, cute. When I was in elementary school, I wanted to ride one.
You, zipping around on a motorbike, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Would it suit me？ Just kidding.
(I kind of want to see that？)
Takane
Ah, someone's moving... Movers have it hard, don't they？
Yeah. They have to carry huge stuff with just a few people.
...When I move, I'll keep my things to a minimum, okay？
Huh, you're moving？
No, I mean in the future.
Takane
Ah, a doggy.
Huh？ Isn't there an owner？
No... Ah. It stopped properly at the crosswalk.
A dog walking itself, wherever it likes...
So there are dogs like that. Amazing.
Takane
Delivery people are always running, aren't they？
That's definitely the image. I saw one earlier too.
Is that a rule, I wonder？
I don't think so... but who knows？
They must get really fit, right？ ...Maybe I'll add that to my training？
(Training... how？)
Takane
Hey, that car being towed by the tow truck just now...
Uh-huh.
It might have been Papa's car.
Huh... What！
It was just for a second, so I might be wrong...
(If so, that would be tough...)
Takane
Ah... Hey, the woman who just turned the corner... didn't she look just like me？
You mean not just the same clothes or something？
No. Like me, but a little more grown up...
！ Where！ Let's go after her！
(Jealous much...)
Takane
Hey, have you ever been to a public bath？
What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Never. So I'd like to try it once.
Then today, the two of us――！
Sounds fun, but... Papa and Mama would be shocked. Maybe they'd allow it if I asked.
Takane
I saw someone getting their hair washed at that barber... They wash it face-down？
Ah, right. At beauty salons it's face-up.
Doesn't the water get on your face？
It does, it does. So I wouldn't recommend it for women wearing makeup.
Hmm... That might be kind of fun.
(She wants to try it？)
Takane
？ Did something just flash？
Hm？ Oh, yeah. Like Morse code... some kind of signal？
▲Takane＊＊▲？
...How do you learn Morse code, I wonder？
(She's interested in that too...)
Takane
Ah, a contrail.
If it stays without fading, that means the weather's going to turn bad.
Really？
Because it means the upper air is humid！ ...I saw it somewhere. By chance.
I see. Then next time, I'll teach someone.
Takane
When we waved back, she waved twice as hard.
Yes. I totally get how she felt. It's fun when someone waves back.
Yaaay, ▲高嶺＊＊▲～▼
Yeees▼ Hehehe！
